prompt:
Production animation sprite sheet for Unity, Rusher. The one reference defines creature silhouette and camera; independently draw continuous poses matching that identity. Matte dark brown rocky armor, light gray-white tendon limbs, restrained amber eye, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D style, sharp legible silhouette at small game scale. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera and upper-left soft lighting. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front. FOUR limbs, single head; no sacs, no flower organs. Preserve the reference's blade-backed charging predator silhouette.
Facing for ALL frames: RIGHT profile facing screen right, nose at right edge of body and tail at left; keep this exact direction in EVERY pose, no turns. Do not rotate the camera or turn the body in later rows.
Strict grid: FOUR columns x 7 rows, exactly 28 full creatures. Canvas aspect width/height=4/7. Each equal square cell reserves at least 15% padding on every side around its creature. Consistent scale, center and foot baseline. NO touching/overlapping neighboring bodies, including wide collapsed corpses. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real articulated four-leg gait, alternating diagonal pairs, lifted feet and planted feet, stable torso. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breath poses, feet planted. Row4: FOUR WINDUP frames: progressively brace hind legs, lower spear head, draw torso backward ready to charge; last frame fully braced. Rows5-6: EIGHT sequential CHARGE SPRINT frames, head lowered and armor forward, vigorous alternating reach/push leg motions, body stays at the same scale and ground anchor. Row7: FOUR DEATH frames: limbs buckle, spear head and plates settle on floor, eyes darken, collapsed corpse, no explosion.
Distinct articulated leg steps, stable four-leg anatomy, single head, consistent plates. Do not simply duplicate or transform one still. Empty background fully transparent alpha0, including between legs. No shadow, floor, labels, text, diagram lines, grid, particles or projectiles.
